_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: Score is coiled inside Denial with no volume/ETF/funding breaker; 7-day base rate makes directional calls low-skill until a flush or reclaim appears.
next_move.brains_agree: Yes on current phase Denial; analyst explicit HOLD, narrative silent/low-conf so no split on direction
next_move.confirmed_if: Fear & Greed holds 30-40, funding near zero, BTC range-bound without volume expansion
next_move.invalidated_if: F&G breaks below 24 on volume flush (Panic) or reclaims above 46 with ETF inflows and CVD follow-through (Anxiety up)
